thesis: Strong growth and cash generation coexist with leverage and inconsistent earnings bases. Neither resolves whether the current price already compensates for expectations.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue rose 53% and continuing profit 64%, providing strong operating evidence beyond the stock rebound.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of negative continuing-operations EPS growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive continuing EPS growth with gross debt/equity below 100%.
evidence_gaps: Continuing-versus-total EPS bridge and debt maturity schedule.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Strong revenue and continuing-profit growth coexist with cash generation
Actual revenue and continuing-profit growth support more than a drawdown trade
